versions.changelog:
genviral-skill v1.0.0

- Initial release of genviral-skill, providing full automation of the Genviral Partner API.
- Enables creation and scheduling of video/slideshow posts across TikTok, Instagram, and more.
- Includes AI-powered image/video generation, post analytics, trend research, and template/pack management.
- Features a comprehensive content pipeline: from media upload to publishing and performance tracking.
- Comes with detailed documentation and a strictly organized workspace for all user data and logs.
